targets.doc: Render a responsive label/value grid from AttributesOptions :items. Each item may carry :label, :value (text or a Respo node), and :span; options also set the title, item size, and CSS overrides.

Render page buttons for a 1-based page out of total pages, collapsing distant pages into gaps. Options: :siblings (pages beside the current one, default 1), :on-change (receives the next page and d!), :class-name, and :style.
Render a controlled radio group from SelectOption items. Options: :name, :label (group aria-label), :vertical?, :disabled, :on-change (receives the picked value and d!), :class-name, and :style.
Render a controlled native select from SelectOption items, each with :value, :label, and optional :disabled. Options: :disabled, :on-change (receives the next value and d!), :class-name, and :style.
Render horizontal or vertical tabs from TabRoute items. TabsOptions sets :selected, :vertical?, :width, and styles; on-route receives the clicked TabRoute.
